task.title: Prevent stale-task context refresh failures
task.summary: Make CodeWiki context refresh ignore closed or archived session-focus task ids and skip compaction when no source-backed resume packet exists.

goal.outcome: Context refresh after task closure no longer tries to resume missing/closed tasks or falls through to fragile generic summarization.
acceptance: Context refresh does not pass stale active session task ids as explicit resume requests.
Explicit stale task ids during context refresh degrade to open roadmap fallback or no-op skip instead of throwing Roadmap task not found/already closed.
Agent-end context refresh preflights CodeWiki summary and skips ctx.compact when no CodeWiki packet exists, avoiding generic summarizer fallback.
Smoke coverage proves stale active task handling and skip behavior.
non_goals: Do not change explicit /wiki-resume TASK-### error behavior.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

requirements.text: CodeWiki-triggered context refresh must not fail when the current session focus points at a closed or archived roadmap task.
CodeWiki-triggered context refresh must skip compaction when no source-backed CodeWiki resume packet exists, so it does not invoke generic summarization as fallback.

closure_brief.user_intent: Fix CodeWiki context refresh so closing/archiving a task cannot trigger Roadmap task not found and WebSocket compaction failure.
implemented_changes: Made active session task links advisory during CodeWiki compaction instead of explicit requested task ids.
Added stale requested-task fallback for CodeWiki compaction summaries only.
Preflighted CodeWiki compaction summaries before calling ctx.compact and skip when no source-backed packet exists.
Cached prepared CodeWiki summary for the session_before_compact hook to avoid rebuilding/falling through.
Added smoke regression coverage for stale active link, explicit stale request fallback, and no-open-task no-op.
Added accepted decision and planning build traceability for TASK-007 implementation validation.
acceptance_evidence: tests/smoke/codewiki-compaction.test.mjs proves stale active session task no longer throws and selects open roadmap fallback.
tests/smoke/codewiki-compaction.test.mjs proves explicit stale context-refresh task falls back or returns null when no open task exists.
Source guard in tests/smoke/codewiki-compaction.test.mjs verifies no-packet skip path exists before ctx.compact.
non_goals_preserved: Did not change explicit /wiki-resume TASK-### behavior.
remaining_risks: Manual/native Pi compaction outside CodeWiki-triggered agent_end can still use Pi's own summarizer when no CodeWiki packet exists.

risks: If Pi triggers a user/manual native compaction outside CodeWiki's agent_end path, session_before_compact still returns undefined when no CodeWiki packet exists, allowing Pi's own summarizer. TASK-007 only prevents CodeWiki-triggered stale-task refreshes from invoking native fallback.

commit.title: fix(pi): prevent stale-task CodeWiki context refresh failures

Make CodeWiki-triggered context refresh ignore stale session-focus task ids, fall back from stale explicit compaction task ids, and skip native compaction when no source-backed CodeWiki resume packet exists.
